censoring.agrees_with_paper: Titration bounds 1e-12..1e-7 M for H1 (-logKD 7..12) and 1e-11..1e-6 M for H3/B (-logKD 6..11); values outside are pinned to the boundary.
censoring.implication: H1 is floor-censored only (1675/65536 = 2.6%). H3 is 89% floor-tied and fluB 99.7%, so neither supports an ordinary ordering metric.
censoring.units: -log10(KD), KD in molar; HIGHER is stronger binding

genotype_column_trap.evidence: Naive read gives a power-of-two length ladder {1:2, 2:2, 3:4, ... 16:32768}; dtype={'genotype': str} gives {16: 65536}.
genotype_column_trap.finding: `genotype` is a 16-character binary STRING with meaningful leading zeros. pandas.read_csv infers int64 and strips them.
genotype_column_trap.severity: silent corruption of half the dataset
genotype_column_trap.why_it_is_dangerous: It raises nothing. pos1..pos16 stay intact, so any consumer keyed on pos* is unaffected and a spot check looks fine, while anything keyed on the genotype string silently mis-maps exactly the half of variants beginning with 0.

manifest_defects_found.claim: The CR9114/CR6261 combinatorial landscapes have 16 editable sites, each with two allowed residues.
manifest_defects_found.verdict: WRONG for CR6261. Phillips et al. report CR9114 with 16 mutations (65,536 variants) and CR6261 with 11 (2,048). The assertion conflates the two landscapes; it was marked verified:false, so nothing had caught it.

manifest_defects_found.claim: specs/benchmarks/README.md: 'There is no path by which an unfilled manifest is mistaken for an approved one.'
manifest_defects_found.verdict: FALSE at the time of this audit, now FIXED. is_approved tested only TODO(owner) sentinels, so filling the four top-level fields returned is_approved True with all 15 owner decisions still unsupplied. validate_source_manifest was never fooled. Now requires both no sentinels and every decision supplied; three regression tests pin the combinations.

replicate_sem_reproduction.conclusion: Every figure in the recommendation reproduces to the digit from a freshly downloaded file. A blanket sqrt(2) correction is wrong: the factor depends on replicate count, and the 1152 singletons have no defined sample SEM at all. Inverse-variance weighting on their reported zeros yields infinite weights.

source_verification.note: Downloaded fresh on Windows and hashed; byte-identical to the hash recorded in fixed-target-data-audit-2026-09-14.json, which was produced on macOS. Two machines, two retrievals, one hash.
